        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title and Lecture Lines
        title = "State Vectors and Probability Amplitudes"
        lines = [
            "Vector projections onto the axes are called amplitudes.",
            "Squaring an amplitude reveals the probability of that state.",
            "Measurement collapses the vector into a single result."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight Line 1 in Yellow
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"))

        # Setup Coordinate System (Axes)
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 1.2, 1],
            y_range=[0, 1.2, 1],
            x_length=3,
            y_length=3,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": WHITE},
            tips=True
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B2", "E4")
        
        # Labels for axes
        label_0 = MathTex("|0\\rangle", font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(1.1, 0), DOWN)
        label_1 = MathTex("|1\\rangle", font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1.1), LEFT)
        
        # Yellow state vector at 45 degrees (1/sqrt(2), 1/sqrt(2))
        amp_val = np.cos(PI/4)
        vec_end = axes.c2p(amp_val, amp_val)
        state_vec = Arrow(axes.c2p(0,0), vec_end, buff=0, color="#FFFF00", stroke_width=4)
        
        # Projections
        proj_x = DashedLine(vec_end, axes.c2p(amp_val, 0), color=WHITE)
        proj_y = DashedLine(vec_end, axes.c2p(0, amp_val), color=WHITE)

        beta_label = MathTex("\\beta", color=WHITE, font_size=30)

        beta_label.move_to(axes.c2p(-0.25, amp_val/2))

        self.play(Create(axes), Write(label_0), Write(label_1))
        self.play(GrowArrow(state_vec))
        self.play(Create(proj_x), Create(proj_y))
        self.play(Write(alpha_label), Write(beta_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # Probability calculations

        self.place_at_grid(prob_beta, "C5", scale_factor=1.0)

        self.play(Write(prob_alpha), Write(prob_beta))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight Line 3 in a Highlight Color (Light Blue)
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#58ACFA"))

        # Measurement collapse: Snap to |0>

        self.wait(2)
